entries.reason: Inconsistent behavior, 403 errors, unreliable. Never worked consistently.
entries.alternative: Use Dataverse workflows table for flow CRUD

entries.pattern: API fix for ActiveUnpublished flow state
entries.reason: No API call clears this state. If someone edited in designer without saving, only designer can resolve.
entries.alternative: User opens flow in designer, clicks Save or Discard

entries.pattern: N:N navigation property $expand for permission-role verification
entries.reason: Platform bug — returns empty array regardless of actual links.
entries.alternative: Read powerpagecomponent content JSON adx_entitypermission_webrole array

entries.reason: V3 retired 2026-04-10. V4 OOXML is sole docgen path. V3 Admin tab, flow, Switch cases all dead.
entries.alternative: V4 OOXML injection via Azure Function + jszip

entries.reason: az CLI is not installed on this machine.
entries.alternative: Use Azure Portal GUI or PowerShell Az module (Az.Accounts only)

entries.pattern: Inline pwsh -Command with OData $ parameters in bash
entries.reason: Bash eats $ signs even in single-quoted strings. OData filters get mangled.
entries.alternative: Write .ps1 file, invoke with pwsh -NoProfile -File path.ps1

entries.pattern: Changing Dataverse table ownership type after creation via API
entries.reason: Ownership type (UserOwned vs OrganizationOwned) is set at creation and cannot be changed via any API or admin UI post-creation. This blocks solution import when source and target envs have mismatched ownership on the same table.
entries.alternative: DELETE the table (losing all data) and recreate with correct ownership — DESTRUCTIVE, requires data migration. Or accept that solution import is blocked for that table and use column-by-column API sync.

entries.pattern: Fully automating Power Automate connection reference wiring via API
entries.reason: Connection references can only be wired by a human adding an action in the Power Automate designer UI. No API path creates a new live connection and binds it to a connection reference without the designer step. 19 scripts were attempted before this constraint was established (engineering journal §5).
entries.alternative: Human opens each flow in Power Automate designer, adds one action per connector type (Dataverse, SharePoint, etc.), saves. After that, scripts can PATCH the full flow definition via the Dataverse workflows table.
